game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood, the glowing ancient tree: the forest ranger must hold off thorn goblins while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Range Runner: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the forest ranger moves exactly n steps toward the heartwood tree.
theme: Mystic Forest – Glowing Heartwood: the glowing ancient tree
core_gameplay_loop: In Glowing Heartwood, repeat each round: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the forest ranger moves exactly n steps toward the heartwood tree. Then check steps_left and advance.
player_objective: Protect the heartwood tree from thorn goblins in Glowing Heartwood: keep steps_left above zero until the 42-second timer ends.
controls: Keyboard: SPACE applies the code fix; H shows a hint; mouse/touch: tap the code panel to choose a value.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 1 (intro tier): Range Runner
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Generic fallback template for Week 5, Level 1, Need Assistance. Deliberately a simple survival game; it is not one of the 2,700 unique pool games and is only used when no pool game can be served.
